newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil inactive, toys with arb to Asia, U.S..
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil inactive, toys with arb to Asia, U.S..

text.p: Arbitrage to the U.S. and Asia provided the main focus in NWE gas oil in contrast to a continuing weak and inactive local market, traders said.

A 62,200 tonne 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil cargo traded to New York late on Thursday at NYMEX heating oil quotes -60 points, equivalent to around $227 a tonne or about $11 over front month gas oil futures in London.
The arb was seen marginal and only workable with large cargoes of that size, traders said.
Jan IPE futures were down $1.50 at $216.50 in thin trade, with forecasts of cold weather in NWE failing to stimulate.

Russian heating oil was discussed steady to slightly weaker at around Jan IPE +$1.50/2.50 for prompt and early January delivery. Refinery grade heating oil was steady on a notional basis at Jan IPE +$4.50/5.50 prompt cif NWE.
Low sulphur diesel was steady but inactive at Jan IPE +$10.
Heating oil was done slightly firmer at $215 to 217.75 a tonne outright for delivery from prompt to January 5, equivalent to Jan IPE -$1/+$1.
Low sulphur was quiet, at around Jan IPE +$13/15.
